title: Build a New Rune Vault From Two Sets and One Rune

steps.intent: start a new Claude tab, and in the Runes panel press New Rune Vault; in the Rune Library on the left tick the First and Second sets and one single rune that is not in either set
press Done, give the vault a name and save it; check the vault list comes back with that vault picked
press Start Session to begin a session on the new vault, without sending a message
check the view lists the runes from First, from Second and the single one I added
check the vault name the session shows is the name I gave, and that Lock still reads Lock
